c2_approved = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
c2_credited = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'
c2_evals = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
c2_wo_evals = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
c2_grade = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

col_debtor = 'Debtor'
col_tuition = 'Tuition fees up to date'
col_sch = 'Scholarship holder'
col_target = 'Target'

# Use Target distribution later to calibrate the alert threshold
# Academic performance features - 1st semester
# ASSERTION_START
assert pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c1_grade]) and df[c1_grade].notna().all() and np.isfinite(df[c1_grade]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
g1 = df[c1_grade] / 20.0
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c1_approved] <= df[c1_enrolled]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
backlog_gap1 = np.sqrt(df[c1_enrolled] - df[c1_approved])
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c1_credited] <= df[c1_approved]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
credit_gap1 = np.sqrt(df[c1_approved] - df[c1_credited])
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c1_wo_evals] <= df[c1_enrolled]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
missing_eval_gap1 = np.sqrt(df[c1_enrolled] - df[c1_wo_evals])
eval_rate1 = (df[c1_evals] / df[c1_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
approval_vs_eval1 = (df[c1_approved] / df[c1_evals].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
pass_rate1 = (df[c1_approved] / df[c1_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

# Academic performance features - 2nd semester
# ASSERTION_START
assert pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c2_grade]) and df[c2_grade].notna().all() and np.isfinite(df[c2_grade]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
g2 = df[c2_grade] / 20.0
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c2_approved] <= df[c2_enrolled]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
backlog_gap2 = np.sqrt(df[c2_enrolled] - df[c2_approved])
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c2_credited] <= df[c2_approved]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
credit_gap2 = np.sqrt(df[c2_approved] - df[c2_credited])
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df[c2_wo_evals] <= df[c2_enrolled]).all()
# ASSERTION_END
missing_eval_gap2 = np.sqrt(df[c2_enrolled] - df[c2_wo_evals])
eval_rate2 = (df[c2_evals] / df[c2_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
# ASSERTION_START
m2_ev0 = df[c2_evals] == 0
assert (df.loc[m2_ev0, c2_approved] == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END
approval_vs_eval2 = (df[c2_approved] / df[c2_evals].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
pass_rate2 = (df[c2_approved] / df[c2_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

cols = [col_tuition, col_debtor, col_sch]
assert all(pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c]) for c in cols)
assert df[cols].notna().all().all()
# ASSERTION_END
financial_component = (df[col_debtor].astype(float) * 1.0) + ((1 - df[col_tuition].astype(float)) * 0.6) - (df[col_sch].astype(float) * 0.2)
financial_component = financial_component.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Aggregate academic signals
grade_norm_avg = 0.6 * g1 + 0.4 * g2
pass_rate_avg = 0.5 * pass_rate1 + 0.5 * pass_rate2
eval_rate_avg = 0.5 * eval_rate1 + 0.5 * eval_rate2

load_gaps = backlog_gap1 + credit_gap1 + missing_eval_gap1 + backlog_gap2 + credit_gap2 + missing_eval_gap2
load_denom = float(max(1.0, np.nanquantile(load_gaps, 0.95)))
backlog_component = (load_gaps / load_denom).clip(0.0, 1.0)

age_component = (df['Age at enrollment'] >= 30).astype(float) * 0.10

risk_raw = (
    0.35 * (1.0 - pass_rate_avg) +
    0.20 * (1.0 - grade_norm_avg) +
    0.15 * (1.0 - eval_rate_avg) +
    0.20 * financial_component +
    0.05 * backlog_component +
    0.05 * age_component
)

risk = risk_raw.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Calibrate alert threshold from current cohort label distribution
dropout_rate = (df[col_target] == 'Dropout').mean()
threshold = float(np.quantile(risk.to_numpy(), 1.0 - dropout_rate))

advising_flag = (risk >= threshold).astype(int)
financial_outreach_flag = ((df[col_debtor] == 1) | ((df[col_tuition] == 0) & (risk >= threshold))).astype(int)

output = pd.DataFrame({
    'student_id': df['student_id'],
    'dropout_risk': risk.round(4),
    'advising_flag': advising_flag,
    'financial_outreach_flag': financial_outreach_flag,
    'advice_threshold': np.repeat(threshold, len(df))
})

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
output.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv'), index=False)

# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_END
missing_eval_gap1 = np.sqrt(df[c1_enrolled] - df[c1_wo_evals])
eval_rate1 = (df[c1_evals] / df[c1_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
approval_vs_eval1 = (df[c1_approved] / df[c1_evals].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
pass_rate1 = (df[c1_approved] / df[c1_enrolled].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

# Academic performance features - 2nd semester
# ASSERTION_START
assert pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c2_grade])
s = df[c2_grade]

# ASSERTION_END
g2 = df[c2_grade] / 20.0
# ASSERTION_START
assert pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c2_enrolled]) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c2_approved])

# Financial features
# ASSERTION_START
cols = [col_tuition, col_debtor, col_sch]
for c in cols:
    s = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    assert s.notna().all() and np.isfinite(s).all()

financial_component = (df[col_debtor].astype(float) * 1.0) + ((1 - df[col_tuition].astype(float)) * 0.6) - (df[col_sch].astype(float) * 0.2)
financial_component = financial_component.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Aggregate academic signals
grade_norm_avg = 0.6 * g1 + 0.4 * g2
pass_rate_avg = 0.5 * pass_rate1 + 0.5 * pass_rate2
eval_rate_avg = 0.5 * eval_rate1 + 0.5 * eval_rate2

load_gaps = backlog_gap1 + credit_gap1 + missing_eval_gap1 + backlog_gap2 + credit_gap2 + missing_eval_gap2
load_denom = float(max(1.0, np.nanquantile(load_gaps, 0.95)))
backlog_component = (load_gaps / load_denom).clip(0.0, 1.0)

age_component = (df['Age at enrollment'] >= 30).astype(float) * 0.10

risk_raw = (
    0.35 * (1.0 - pass_rate_avg) +
    0.20 * (1.0 - grade_norm_avg) +
    0.15 * (1.0 - eval_rate_avg) +
    0.20 * financial_component +
    0.05 * backlog_component +
    0.05 * age_component
)

risk = risk_raw.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Calibrate alert threshold from current cohort label distribution
dropout_rate = (df[col_target] == 'Dropout').mean()
threshold = float(np.quantile(risk.to_numpy(), 1.0 - dropout_rate))

advising_flag = (risk >= threshold).astype(int)
financial_outreach_flag = ((df[col_debtor] == 1) | ((df[col_tuition] == 0) & (risk >= threshold))).astype(int)

output = pd.DataFrame({
    'student_id': df['student_id'],
    'dropout_risk': risk.round(4),
    'advising_flag': advising_flag,
    'financial_outreach_flag': financial_outreach_flag,
    'advice_threshold': np.repeat(threshold, len(df))
})

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
output.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv'), index=False)
